# Annie Makes Studio

> A creative production house crafting cinematic storytelling, VFX, animation, AI-driven content, and 3D modeling.

Annie Makes Studio is an independent creative studio offering VFX, 3D modeling, AI content, animation, and video production for brands, filmmakers, and agencies.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Studio overview, services, featured work, and contact.
- [Red Horizon — VFX](/work/4): Sci-fi VFX showcase blending practical lighting and CG environments.
- [Form & Light — 3D Models](/work/5): 3D modeling and rendering — form, material, and light in cinematic frames.
- [Go Zero — Ice Cream Ad](/work/1): High-energy commercial film combining cinematic storytelling and sleek VFX.
- [Through the Lens — Short Film](/work/2): Intimate short film exploring the craft of filmmaking.
- [Above the Clouds — Documentary](/work/3): Documentary capturing the silent vastness of mountain ecosystems at dawn.
